18/S0.subgoal: Categorize the main tracking technologies used in VR and AR.

18/S1.subgoal: Describe electromechanical trackers and distinguish world-fixed and wearable types.

18/S2.subgoal: Explain electromagnetic and acoustic/ultrasonic trackers, including transmitter-receiver operation and the line-of-sight difference.

18/S3.subgoal: Explain vision-based tracking and infrared tracking, including outside-in and inside-out configurations.

18/S4.subgoal: Explain visible light tracking and fiducial tracking using artificial landmarks.

18/S5.subgoal: Describe natural feature tracking using feature detection, descriptors, and pose matching.

18/S6.subgoal: Explain model-based tracking using SLAM and PTAM.

18/S7.subgoal: Describe 3D structure tracking using depth sensors and created 3D models.

18/S8.subgoal: Explain inertial tracking and additional positional sensors such as GPS, including RTK and limitations.

18/S9.subgoal: Describe motion capture, eye tracking, and hybrid tracking methods.

18/S10.subgoal: Summarize the lecture's tracking technologies and preview the next lecture.
